historical_reviews.deepseek: Captures the desired final state but changes resource scope and supplies no proof that the action produced an off-to-on transition or completed boot.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly requires chassis-resource validation, explicit authority and multi-stage recovery evidence.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: An On request from an already-on chassis is a no-op with the same final state. The precondition must therefore be a contemporaneous, independently confirmed off state, and success must include both physical/chassis energization and the separately observable host boot sequence.

original_test_intent: Verify that one authorized isolated chassis transitions from a confirmed off state to on after exactly one supported Chassis.Reset On action and that its host completes the approved POST/boot readiness sequence.
original_method: Discover the exact chassis and related ComputerSystem, independently prove the chassis is off, validate the firmware On action/readback contract, confirm no maintenance conflict and an available recovery console, obtain approval, issue one protected POST, correlate chassis/IPMI on state with console POST and OS readiness, and retain logs without retry or automatic power-off.
manual_activity: The chassis/system owner confirms the intentional off baseline and maintenance window, explicitly authorizes the On action, observes the console and decides any separately approved intervention if POST or OS recovery stalls.
safety_requirements: Never expose secrets or use unapproved TLS bypass
Do not substitute System.Reset without proof
Do not issue On when already on
Do not auto-reset or power off failed boot
agent_execution_scope: Confirm independent off pre-state and recovery path
Monitor console POST and OS readiness
engineer_actions: Approve target, off baseline and power-on window

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The ResetType matches, but the unapproved ComputerSystem endpoint, insecure curl and final-only IPMI status omit source resource semantics, off pre-state and host boot coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After discovery proves the chassis resource and independent reads prove it is off, obtain approval and POST one supported `ResetType: On` through trusted TLS; capture the authoritative chassis field, IPMI state, console POST and OS readiness.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The chassis off-to-on intent and 10/20-minute window remain; default credentials, log clearing, System endpoint substitution, duplicate actions and automatic cleanup are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record the discovered resource graph and a monotonic timeline from off-state proof and approval through action/task, chassis/IPMI energization, POST milestones and OS readiness.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the missing pre-state, physical/logical resource binding and operational end-state to the response-only flow.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A final On field cannot prove the request changed state, the correct chassis was targeted or the attached host booted successfully.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Power-on can start scheduled services and workloads or expose latent boot faults. This testcase does not authorize repair, reset or subsequent shutdown.

project_override_considerations: The Project must approve the Chassis.Reset On capability and the relationship between chassis power and host readiness. If the platform supports On only through ComputerSystem.Reset, that alternate path requires an explicit resource-equivalence decision before use.
expected_evidence: Firmware On action contract and authoritative readback
Independent off-state proof, maintenance approval and recovery-path check
Trusted TLS/auth/client metadata with secrets redacted
Complete POST response/task and exactly-one-command audit
Chassis/IPMI on timeline, console POST, OS readiness, preserved logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Chassis.Reset payload and On criterion consistently target chassis power-on. DeepSeek's ComputerSystem endpoint substitution is a reference mismatch, not a competing Master objective.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The chassis action contract, resource mapping, off baseline and recovery path are identifiable project inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED if the physical power domain or supported action cannot be established after the normal request.

review_improvement: Requires a real off-to-operational transition on the intended chassis instead of accepting an insecure request and a final-only status.
independent_technical_reasoning: Power-on correctness depends on initial state, affected domain and terminal readiness. Without off-state proof there is no transition; without the resource graph the action may address a different logical object; without POST/OS evidence chassis power alone does not cover the host outcome. These observables must be correlated before the engineer judges the case.
